name: PBF Displacement Calculation with Grid-Based Neighbor Search
definition: A Particle-Based Fluid (PBF) simulation step that calculates particle displacements based on density constraints. It uses a spatial hash grid to find neighboring particles within a search radius and applies separation forces to enforce incompressibility.
summary: This PBF simulation step enforces incompressibility by using a spatial hash grid to efficiently find neighbors and apply separation forces to overlapping particles.
